answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the anchor of a task receipt, and the island is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
